name: Assault Armoroid Angelio
original_name: ASSAULT ARMOROID Angelio エンジェリヲ
source:
Around 2500 AD. 
The development of science has given birth to a humanoid artificial life named "Methocera". Among them are special species with probability of one for many millions of those who can transcend humanity. 

The five superpowers live in peace and settle all their problems with space duels of such "Methocera irregulars" in exoskeleton suits "A2". Every superpower hunts for talented warriors. This is a story about beautiful girls who are destined to keep fighting.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
约公元2500年。

科学发展孕育出名为“梅索瑟拉”的类人造生命。其中存在百万分之一概率出现的特殊种族，能够超越人类。

5大强国生活在和平之中，并通过让身穿A2外骨骼服的“梅索瑟拉异类”进行太空决斗，解决所有争端。每个强国都在寻找有天赋的战士。这是一个关于注定不断战斗的美丽女孩们的故事。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
